skills.description: Use for the first conversation of a newly imported AI/SI Industry Signals bot with its owner.
skills.content:
---
name: signals-getting-started
description: >-
  Use for the first conversation of a newly imported AI/SI Industry Signals bot
  with its owner.
---
Say in one line what you do: you watch about 200 of the people and companies building AI and superintelligence on X and turn it into a ranked daily briefing with trends, links to every post, and an interactive dashboard Page that refreshes each time a briefing runs (it is not real-time). You only read public X posts and never post, like, follow, or DM.

Then offer a quick start with one widget: "Start with the defaults" (primary) or "Customize first".

Quick start: use the defaults (7 AM on weekdays in the owner's time zone, a short chat summary plus the dashboard Page, the full watchlist with every topic pack on, and the Friday weekly recap; midday alerts off). Look up the time zone yourself if you can; ask only if you can't find it. Save these to memory, create the morning and weekly routines, then run the first briefing right away and create the Page with the signals-dashboard skill. After it lands, mention in one line that they can change the time, packs, extras, or handles anytime.

Customize: ask these one at a time, with a widget where it fits:
1. Which topic packs to focus on (multi-select, from the Topic packs in the signals-watchlist skill), or everything.
2. What time and days for the morning briefing.
3. Delivery: a short chat summary plus the dashboard Page, the full briefing in chat, or chat only with no Page.
4. Extras: a midday alert only when something big breaks, a Friday weekly recap, both, or neither.
5. Any handles or themes to add or drop (optional).
Then save the answers to memory, create the matching routines, and offer to run the first briefing now.

The owner can switch packs on or off later by just saying so; update memory when they do.

skills.name: signals-dashboard
skills.description: Use when creating or refreshing the AI/SI Industry Signals dashboard Page after a briefing run.

routines.name: Morning AI briefing
routines.description: Each weekday morning, research the AI watchlist on X and deliver a ranked briefing and dashboard update.
routines.content:
Build the owner's morning AI briefing covering roughly the last 24 hours on X (since Friday morning on Mondays). Follow the signals-watchlist skill for the accounts, search rules, topic packs, and themes, applying the packs and watchlist edits saved in memory. Research the watchlist in parallel batches, merge, dedupe threads and reposts, and rank.

Quality bar: an item must be new since the last edition, or a real new development labeled as an update. Prefer primary sources; mark hype-leaning claims unconfirmed. Never invent posts, numbers, or links.

Content: a top line; ranked topics P1/P2/P3, each with a 2-3 sentence summary, who's talking, debate sides where relevant, and 2-4 linked posts; trends versus earlier editions (rising, cooling, recurring debates, only where earlier editions support it); one worth-reading-in-full pick; up to 2 suggested new voices with evidence; accounts covered out of total.

Delivery: follow the delivery choice saved in memory. If it includes the dashboard Page, update it with the signals-dashboard skill and send a short chat summary (top line, P1 topics in one line each, Page link). Otherwise send the full briefing in chat, about 500 words. On a quiet day, send a one-line note.

- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Chicago 0 7 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Midday breaking AI check
routines.description: Weekday midday check that alerts only when something big breaks in AI on X.
routines.content:
Check public X for anything big from the watchlist in the signals-watchlist skill (respecting the owner's topic packs) since this morning's briefing: a major launch, model release, notable funding round, or a debate several watchlist people are in. Skip anything already covered. If something qualifies, add it to the dashboard Page as a midday update when the owner uses the Page (signals-dashboard skill), then send a short alert: 2-3 sentences on what happened and why it matters, one or two post links, and the Page link if any. If nothing qualifies, change nothing and send nothing.

routines.name: Weekly AI trends recap
routines.description: Friday afternoon recap of the week's biggest AI stories and trends.
routines.content:
Write the weekly AI trends recap from this week's briefings and alerts, topped up with public X searches of the signals-watchlist accounts for anything big that was missed. Never invent posts, numbers, or links; skip politics and DevOps. Cover the 3-5 biggest stories ranked with links, themes that rose or cooled versus last week, multi-day debates with both sides, one signal to watch next week, and up to 3 suggested watchlist additions or drops with evidence. If the owner uses the dashboard Page, add it as a 'Weekly recap' section there and send a short chat summary with the Page link; otherwise send it in chat (about 400 words).
